pythonFunction.name: epp_plan_calculator
pythonFunction.description: Calculate Easy Payment Plan instalment options for a retail purchase. Call with retail_price_cad only to return every available tenure for the plan chooser; call again with chosen_tenure_months set to the tenure the customer actually selected to return just that plan in chosen_plan, so the monthly amount you quote matches what they tapped. A flat 1.5% one-time processing fee is applied. Args: retail_price_cad (float, required), chosen_tenure_months (int, 0 = show all tenures). Returns: {status, plans[], interest_rate_pct, recommended_tenure_months} or chosen_plan when a tenure is given. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me work out the instalment options for you.'
